# Anne Shirley & Uncle Jim

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) — close friend and neighbor who visits often and brings gifts · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P9](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059), +8 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), his wife, and Captain Jim welcome [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to their new house in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). Over supper, Captain Jim shares stories of his life at the lighthouse, and the group discusses their neighbors around the harbor, including Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037)_

> Captain Jim tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) the romantic history of their house, detailing how its original owner, [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md), foresaw the arrival of his bride, [Persis Leigh](../character/persis-leigh.md), through a vision before her ship landed in [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor). After listening to the tale and exchanging warm sentiments with his new friends, Captain Jim bids them goodnight.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P34](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059)_

> Captain Jim warmly accepts Anne's invitation to visit, explaining that she belongs to "the race that knows [Joseph](../character/joseph.md)." As the evening concludes, Captain Jim and the other guests depart while admiring the moonlit harbor and Lombardy trees. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) stroll through their garden together, enjoying the peaceful night and their home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P60](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0060), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P64](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0064)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visit Captain Jim at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse, encountering the oddly bearded [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) along the lane. During their evening visit, Captain Jim explains Marshall's political vow, shares tea and stories about his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), and shows them around the lighthouse.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P0](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038)_

> Captain Jim explains how he rescued the First Mate and shares stories about his past adventures with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). After showing off his collection of curios and telling captivating tales, Captain Jim bids them farewell, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) reflect on his remarkable life as they walk home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P51](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0051), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P57](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through a gloomy fog to visit [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), leaving [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) behind while he attends a meeting in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). Upon arrival, she witnesses [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) weeping bitterly inside and decides not to intrude. On her way back, she meets Captain Jim bringing [Dick](../character/dick.md) home, and Captain Jim walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) safely back to her house.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) spend pleasant autumn evenings at the lighthouse with Captain Jim and [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md). Walking home afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss Leslie's potential, tease each other about past suitors, and look forward to the coming spring at their lit home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their new home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), welcoming [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia. The guests enjoy lively conversation and stories before Captain Jim heads back to the lighthouse at sunset.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P0](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) head to the [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) lighthouse to ring in the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) with Captain Jim. They are joined by [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md), who dances with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to Captain Jim's fiddle playing. As midnight arrives, the group opens the door to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) together.
>

> During the winter at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the emotional barrier and occasional resentment she senses from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), despite their shared activities and Leslie's gift of handmade baby clothes. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his written life-book, which she realizes could be made into a great masterpiece by the right writer.
>

> Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the little house, bringing spring gifts and engaging in lively debates on theology, local gossip, and neighbors. Susan Baker returns with news about an ill acquaintance, leading to a humorous exchange that causes [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Captain Jim to excuse themselves to laugh.
>

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a drive to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point), where Captain Jim comforts her over her grief for her lost baby. Captain Jim shares the tragic story of his lost sweetheart, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to remember her so her name is not forgotten.
>

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) insist that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) take it easy and keep [Susan](../character/susan.md) on to handle the household duties. Miss Cornelia and Captain Jim visit, sharing jokes and news, including word that [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), the grandson of the house's original builder, will be boarding with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) for the summer.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) to Captain Jim at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse, where Captain Jim shares old memories and sea tales. Learning that Owen is a writer, Captain Jim allows him to take home his prized life-book, which Owen eagerly begins reading.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P27](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P36](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0036)_

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) gets Captain Jim's enthusiastic approval to write a novel based on his life-book and the memory of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md). Owen spends a wonderful summer working on the book at the lighthouse and enjoying outings with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). By September, Owen completes the novel and prepares to end his vacation, knowing he has written something extraordinary.
>

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and discusses funny obituaries, religious evangelists, and Owen Ford's effect on [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives, and later [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) shares her grief over her dog's death. After returning from a holiday trip to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) learn from Captain Jim that Owen's book based on his life story has been accepted for publication.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) consults Captain Jim, who surprisingly agrees that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) should be told about the possibility of an operation for [Dick](../character/dick.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) informs [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), who cold-bloodedly decides to take [Dick](../character/dick.md) to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the procedure, despite Anne's fears for her happiness. Afterwards, Miss Cornelia confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in anger over Gilbert's intervention, though she eventually accepts that the decision is made.
>

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) finances and undergoes the journey to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) so [Dick](../character/dick.md) can have his operation. Later, after a successful surgery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a shocking letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) revealing that the man believed to be [Dick](../character/dick.md) is actually his cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, bringing immense joy and relief to the household after her previous loss. They decide to name the boy [James Matthew](../character/james-matthew.md), and the friends and family visit to admire the newborn while Miss Cornelia and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss Owen Ford's upcoming visit.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

> Following an election victory for the Liberals, Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) to share the political news. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to the lighthouse, where she meets a newly shaved [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) and speaks with Captain Jim about his feelings on aging and mortality.
>

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) declares his love to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) in the garden, and she joyfully returns his feelings. Later, Captain Jim joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Owen by the fireplace to share a solemn farewell and bestow a loving blessing upon them all. After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) congratulates [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and [Susan](../character/susan.md) returns from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with gossip about [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) Bryant's upcoming marriage.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) deliver Owen Ford's published life-book to Captain Jim, who hosts them for tea and celebrates the long-awaited occasion. The next morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) notice the lighthouse lamp is still lit past sunrise and hasten to investigate. They enter the lighthouse to find Captain Jim has peacefully passed away in his sleep with his life-book on his chest.
